runs.text: The paper does not say that. The premise is incorrect: the ultra-fast formation protocol is not reported to have degraded performance after
cycles. The paper states the opposite. Discussing the ORNL ultra-fast formation for NMC532/graphite pouch cells, it says:

runs.quote: No per-formance difference after 300 1C/-1C cycles was observed

runs.text: for the ultra-fast formation protocols when compared to the baseline

. The stated purpose of the ultra-fast formation cycling is to preserve the capacities obtained from the improved electrode processing methods during long-term testing. The paper gives no degradation mechanism for the ultra-fast protocol at that cycle count.

The stated purpose of the ultra-fast formation cycling is to preserve the capacities obtained from the improved electrode processing methods during long-term testing. The paper gives no degradation mechanism for the ultra-fast protocol at that cycle count.
